coverage.target: NFR1 (feed content displays within 2 seconds) is specifically FeedUnit's request path; DonationUnit shares no request path with the feed's content-display flow
NFR3.1 (payment data handling / PCI scope reduction) — this Unit is NFR3's primary owner
NFR5.1, NFR5.2 (payment reconciliation and idempotency) — this Unit is NFR5's primary owner
NFR3.5 (services/-layer access boundary and mandatory self-review before merging payment-handling changes)
Accessibility (WCAG AA baseline) is a UI-rendering concern owned by flutter-app-unit; DonationUnit has no UI of its own
Testing methodology/coverage floor is a cross-cutting Build and Test concern, not a Unit-level NFR target

note: performance-requirements.md (NFR-PERF.1, NFR-PERF.2), scalability-requirements.md (NFR-SC.1), and observability-requirements.md (NFR-OBS.1-4) are intentionally outside the NFR1-NFR8 inheritance chain above: inception's requirements.md defines no performance/scalability/observability NFR for this Unit's own request paths (NFR1 is specifically FeedUnit's), so these files use Unit-local IDs rather than a fabricated inception sub-ID — the same discipline auth-unit's NFR review (R-06) established should apply project-wide.
